§6Gas Intake§f mounts on the side of a rocket frame to collect atmospheric gases during flight. It scoops oxygen, nitrogen, and trace gases from a planet's atmosphere at high altitude.

Craft it: 4 Titanium Sticks in corners, 4 Hoppers on edges, 1 Machine Structure in center. Place the intake on the side of the rocket frame facing the planet's atmosphere during descent.

The intake draws gases from the air block in front of it and stores them in a small internal tank. Multiple intakes can be stacked on different faces for parallel collection.

§ePS:§f For best gas collection, point the intake downward and forward of the rocket's nose. Gases accumulate at low pressure and the intake must face the airflow.
